reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures. Boxes B-F are printed with a leading '$' and a thousands comma ('$6,200'); per the spec the '$' is dropped and the comma kept verbatim. Box A is printed as a bare '0' and Balance at Close as '$0'. The Office field prints the seat letter in straight double quotes: Utah County Commission Seat "C". The report-type checkbox marked is '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination', consistent with index.csv's 'Eliminated or Withdrawn'. Address/city/state/zip are redacted upstream by the county (a single black bar across the whole row), so residence_city is ''. The signature is an Adobe digital signature reading 'Digitally signed by Andrew K Jackson / Date: 2024.05.19 15:45:46 -06'00'' - one day AFTER the 05/18/24 the filer typed in the Date and Date of Report boxes; report_date follows the form's own date fields as printed.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' ($6,200) on the p4 Summary Page — also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($6,200) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received / Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' ($6,200)
contributions.detail: The 9 Schedule A rows sum to 300 + 100 + 1000 + 1000 + 100 + 100 + 100.00 + 1500 + 2000 = 6200.00 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C (Year to Date) also prints $6,200 and is NOT summed as an increment; this is the filer's only report of the cycle (a 30-days-after-withdrawal report), so period and year-to-date coincide. 9 of the grid's 15 printed rows are used; rows 10-15 are empty (crop-proved one band past). The filer prints amounts with a leading '$' and a thousands comma; the currency symbol and comma are formatting and the rows carry the plain decimal, with the printed form quoted in each note.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($6,200) on the p4 Summary Page — also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (6200) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (6200)
expenditures.detail: The 15 Schedule B rows sum to 4000 + 786.06 + 297.58 + 153.48 + 10.00 + 46.40 + 26.00 + 0.46 + 54.67 + 500.00 + 98.06 + 55.85 + 41.70 + 84.34 + 45.40 = 6200.00 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and Box D. Box E (Year to Date) prints the same and is not summed. THE GRID IS FULL: all 15 printed rows are used, so the 'one band past the last row' control cannot be taken inside the grid (J6). It was taken OUTSIDE the grid instead — pct:78.0,84.20,20.0,4.60@p3 rendered the printed line 'age $ 6200', i.e. the 'Subtotal for this page' label and its figure, not a sixteenth entry. No ledger continues below the last printed rule.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — the v. 12.23 Schedule A on this filing has four columns (Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox, and no row on either schedule carries an in-kind annotation. Both conventions were tested on both sides and give the same sum here (no in-kind rows exist); monetary-only closes both sides exactly at 6200.00. Determined for THIS filing, not inherited.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell was doubtful — this is a born-digital fillable form printed and re-scanned, so every figure is clean machine type. The five geometry-proof crops (900 dpi) doubled as reads of the extreme rows on both schedules and each reproduced its recorded figure exactly.

itemized.notes: modern_boxAF, form revision v. 12.23, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' (LAST — located by content). NO CHECKLIST bound. pdfinfo: 4 pages, all rot: 0. This filing FOLIATES ITSELF COMPLETELY AND CONSISTENTLY — 'Page 1 of 4', '2 of 4', '3 of 4', '4 of 4' — so the retained document is complete as filed; a rarity in this corpus, where eight different foliation practices have been recorded. Page-face candidate 'Andrew K Jackson'; page-face Office box reads 'Utah County Commission Seat "C"' (the filer punctuates the seat letter in quotes), agreeing with index.csv 'County Commission Seat C' — the seat is PRINTED here and was not inferred. Report type ticked: '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination'; amendment question ticked NO; Date of Report 05/18/24 on all four sheets. The signature is a DIGITAL signature block reading 'Digitally signed by Andrew K Jackson, Date: 2024.05.19 15:45:46 -06'00'' — i.e. the document was signed on 05/19 while every Date-of-Report box reads 05/18/24; both are recorded and neither is adjudicated. SUMMARY BOXES CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE SHEET HEADINGS (L1 screen): Schedule A's total lands in Box B and Schedule B's in Box D — no swap; A=0, F=$6,200=A+B, close box $0 = F-D, so the filer's ladder is internally consistent. NOTE ON THE ADDRESS COLUMN: this is one of the 2024 filings the county published in the CLEAR on the donor side — but the filer never wrote a street line at all, using the 'Address and Zip Code' column for city and state only (the benign G3 case: the column's content, not its heading, decides what it holds). PRIVACY: the candidate's own address row on the cover is fully blacked out by the county, while his PHONE NUMBER is published in the clear immediately beside it — the phone number is deliberately NOT carried into this record, in any field or note, exactly as it would not be from a redacted copy.
